title: Our Place in the Sun Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Check out the never before for rent luxury build Our Place in the Sun with designer furnishings and build outs throughout. Custom chef's kitchen w/dream high end appliances, amazing outdoor porches, and tower with incredible gulf. & sunset views. 3 Kings!
description_expanded: Description36 East Ruskin Street3 Kings, 1 Queen (sleeps 8 total) Welcome to Our Place in the Sun | Luxury Vacation Rental in Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Our Place in the Sun, a brand-new luxury home in Seaside, Florida, offered for rental for the very first time. Perfectly located just 351 feet from the beach and one block from the iconic Seaside Amphitheater, this exceptional residence pairs refined coastal design with one of the most walkable and desirable locations in Seaside. Thoughtfully designed for comfort, connection, and elevated living, this home is ideal for families and groups seeking a true Seaside luxury experience.Outdoor Living Designed for Coastal RelaxationGuests are welcomed by two expansive, open-air furnished porches, one on each level, spanning the full length of the home. The first-floor porch features comfortable club seating and an intimate dining set for three—an inviting space for morning coffee, afternoon lounging, or evening conversations in the sea breeze. These generous outdoor spaces allow the home to live large while embracing Seaside’s relaxed coastal lifestyle.Chef’s Kitchen & Open-Concept LivingAt the heart of the home is a custom chef’s kitchen, anchored by a striking 10-foot quartzite island with seating for four. High-end finishes include top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf gas range with center griddle, farmhouse sink, and abundant custom cabinetry. Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining area features a large farmhouse table with built-in bench seating for eight or more, ideal for shared meals and gatherings. The living room invites relaxation with two oversized sofas, club chairs, and a large flat-screen TV—perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach.First-Floor Guest Suite & ConvenienceAlso located on the first floor is a queen bedroom with an ensuite bath, offering privacy and convenience for guests who prefer main-level accommodations. A separate half bath on this level adds ease for entertaining and daily living.Second-Floor Bedrooms & Private RetreatsUpstairs, a secondary den with two sofas creates an additional family gathering space before leading to three beautifully appointed king bedrooms. The front-facing king primary suite features private porch access, a walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom with dual vanities, a makeup station, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower. The private porch, furnished with rocking chairs and a hammock, offers a peaceful treetop retreat. The second king bedroom includes a walk-in closet and ensuite bath with a glass-enclosed shower, while the third king bedroom offers a walk-in closet and an ensuite bath with a tub/shower combination—each space designed with comfort and privacy in mind.Glass-Enclosed Tower with Gulf ViewsCrowning the home is a spectacular third-floor glass-enclosed tower with an open-air balcony capturing sweeping Gulf views and unforgettable sunsets over Seaside. This level includes a convenient landing with a half bath and beverage fridge, while the tower itself features bar seating and club chairs—the perfect setting for evening cocktails, sunset watching, or peaceful sunrise moments.An Exceptional Seaside, Florida Vacation ExperienceBlending craftsmanship, luxury finishes, and an unbeatable location, Our Place in the Sun delivers an extraordinary Seaside, Florida vacation rental experience. From its proximity to the beach and town square to its thoughtfully curated living spaces and stunning tower views, this home offers the very best of Seaside living.Need More Room?This property also features a separate back house on the premises, available to rent. For additional space or traveling with a larger group, consider reserving both homes together - Arise and Shine.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.Features2,923 square feet351 feet to beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion, offering one of the largest private residential beaches on 30AChef’s kitchen with a commercial Sub-Zero refrigerator and a Wolf cooktop with griddleThree king bedroomsBeverage refrigerator in the towerBike rack for four bikesPrivate parking for two vehicles in front of the home (driveway reserved for rear guest cottage)Access to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.No pets allowed
